up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for the compound CHEMBL3182437 and its salt forms (identified via molecule_hierarchy) against the target Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 1/WD repeat-containing protein 48 (CHEMBL3430885). The query must join activities with compound_structures to get canonical SMILES, target_dictionary for target confirmation, molecule_dictionary for compound names, docs for literature references (title, year, doi), and assays for assay details. Do not filter by unit or relation, just standard_type = 'IC50'. Return compound identifiers (chembl_id), canonical SMILES, target name, activity value and units, relation, document title, year, DOI, and assay ID.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS compound_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_relation,
    d.title AS document_title,
    d.year,
    d.doi,
    ass.assay_id
FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
    (
        mh.parent_molregno IN (
            SELECT parent_molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy WHERE molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437')
            UNION
            SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437'
        )
    )
    AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3430885'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
